dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Does Nara friend have a vibrant Starshroom? Want <color=#00E1FFFF>one Viparyas and one vibrant Starshroom</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Not withered or ordinary Starshroom. It's <color=#00E1FFFF>vibrant Starshroom and Viparyas.</color> One of each will do.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Nara friend has a big "luggage"? Nara friend has everything... Thanks, kind Nara!

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Thank you, Nara. It's time for me to go. May Aramuhukunda watch over Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's the creature we saw before! What's going on here?
